verses.text: Save me, God, by your power and prove that I am right.
Listen to my prayer and hear what I say.
Cruel strangers have attacked and want me dead. Not one of them cares about you.
You will help me, Lord God, and keep me from falling;
you will punish my enemies for their evil deeds. Be my faithful friend and destroy them.
I will bring a gift and offer a sacrifice to you, LORD. I will praise your name because you are good.
You have rescued me from all my troubles, and my own eyes have seen my enemies fall.
